description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and functions related to widget components in the Thingsboard platform, including WidgetContext, WidgetAction, and related data structures, as well as utility functions for widget info conversion and entity parameter updates.

classes.name: WidgetContext
classes.description: Provides context and utility functions for widget components, managing state, subscriptions, UI updates, and interactions within the dashboard environment.

classes.name: LabelVariablePattern
classes.description: Handles dynamic label patterns with variable substitution for widget labels.

methods.name: registerPopoverComponent
methods.description: Registers a popover component for the widget context.

methods.name: updatePopoverPositions
methods.description: Updates positions of all registered popover components.

methods.name: setPopoversHidden
methods.description: Sets visibility of all registered popover components.

methods.name: registerLabelPattern
methods.description: Registers or updates a label pattern with variable substitution.

methods.name: updateLabelPatterns
methods.description: Updates all label patterns.

methods.name: showSuccessToast
methods.description: Displays a success notification toast.

methods.name: showInfoToast
methods.description: Displays an informational notification toast.

methods.name: showWarnToast
methods.description: Displays a warning notification toast.

methods.name: showErrorToast
methods.description: Displays an error notification toast.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Dispatches an action to show a notification toast.

methods.name: hideToast
methods.description: Dispatches an action to hide notification toasts.

methods.name: detectChanges
methods.description: Triggers change detection for the widget, optionally updating widget parameters.

methods.name: detectContainerChanges
methods.description: Triggers change detection for the widget container.

methods.name: updateWidgetParams
methods.description: Requests widget to update its parameters.

methods.name: updateParamsFromData
methods.description: Updates widget parameters based on current data.

methods.name: updateAliases
methods.description: Updates alias controllers with specified alias IDs.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets widget context state to initial.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and marks the context as destroyed.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Closes the current dialog with optional result data.

methods.name: pageLink
methods.description: Creates a PageLink object for pagination.

methods.name: timePageLink
methods.description: Creates a TimePageLink object for time-based pagination.

methods.name: alarmQuery
methods.description: Creates an AlarmQuery object for querying alarms.
